description: End a long engineering session cleanly under token and attention pressure: freeze the in-flight set, delegate execution to subagents and judgement to an independent reviewer, and drive every item to one of three exits — merged, deferred with a record, or operator-blocked with a decision brief — then a clean baseline, a reconciled tracker, and a release-worthiness advisory. Use when the operator says "wrap it up", "clean baseline", "close out the session", "ready for the next iteration", or the context is filling. Not `get-it-done` (which grows the set); this closes a set frozen at invocation.
